checks.name: Zero I/O in join path
checks.description: src/engine/transition.zig PARALLEL_GATEWAY join path (processNodeEntry, incoming_count > 1 branch) must contain zero I/O: no DB calls, no file ops, no network
checks.detail: The join path (lines ~425–620 of transition.zig) uses only: std.ArrayList (pure allocator-backed memory), std.mem.eql, std.mem.order, std.fmt.allocPrint (string formatting), and recursive processNodeEntry calls. No std.fs.*, no db.*, no std.net.* calls anywhere in the join path. The allocator is a pure memory resource — not I/O. Zero I/O invariant holds.

checks.name: PARALLEL_JOIN event schema matches design
checks.description: ParallelJoinPayload struct in transition.zig must match Section EE-07 §4 of src/design/engine.md
checks.detail: Design spec (engine.md §EE-07 §4) defines: join_node_id: []const u8, branch_ids_arrived: [][]const u8, branch_ids_cancelled: [][]const u8, outgoing_token_id: []const u8. Implementation (transition.zig lines 32–37): pub const ParallelJoinPayload = struct { join_node_id: []const u8, branch_ids_arrived: [][]const u8, branch_ids_cancelled: [][]const u8, outgoing_token_id: []const u8 }. All four fields match exactly in name and type.

checks.name: InstanceState.cancelled_branch_ids field present
checks.description: InstanceState must include cancelled_branch_ids: [][]const u8 per EE-07 design §1b
checks.detail: transition.zig InstanceState struct includes: cancelled_branch_ids: [][]const u8 = &[_][]const u8{} (with default empty initialiser as required for backward compatibility). Field is correctly used by the join path to exclude cancelled branches from the arrival threshold computation.

advisory_notes: EE-07-TC-06 (additional coverage — wait path) also passes and verifies the join waits correctly when only 1 of 2 branches has arrived. Not a primary AC mapping but increases confidence.

DB-03 exactly-once guarantee (row-level locking) is a caller-side enforcement; the unit tests exercise the pure join logic. Integration-level verification (DB-03) is deferred to the full WF-04 integration test run.

release_recommendation.rationale: All 5 acceptance criteria covered by passing unit tests, zig build is clean, the join path is provably I/O-free, and the PARALLEL_JOIN event schema exactly matches the design specification. No blocking issues found.
